    How to use it

    Ask as you would ask a friend. With the skill on, the AI keeps your figures, researches the rest, and hands you the link. It does not give the answer itself: the tool does, once you open the link.

    should I pay cash for a $45,000 car or take a 5-year loan at 7.9% and invest the cash?

    Using skill brotools-financingvscash Ran scripts/build_link.py: link checked

    Your inputs

    • Cash Purchase Cost: $45,000

    Assumptions

    1. Cash on hand: 60,000, which the user did not state, kept at the car Quick Start's level so the cash covers the price.
    2. The loan: a single offer over 5 years at 7.9% a year, repaid monthly, with no deposit and no fees because the user mentioned none. It replaces the car Quick Start's three offers.
    3. Interest on spare cash: 4.5% a year, a typical savings or term deposit rate, used for the cash that is invested instead of spent.

    Your scenario

    Open Finance vs Cash on this scenario

    https://tool.adjiebrotots.com/financingvscash/#load&v=1&qs=car&purchaseCost=45000&availableCash=60000&why.availableCash=The%20user%20did%20not%20say%20how%20much%20cash%20they%20hold,%20so%20a%20round%20amount%20above%20the%20price,%20as%20the%20car%20Quick%20Start%20assumes&offers=5-year%20loan%20at%207.9%25:financeRate=7.9:termYears=5&why.offers=One%20loan%20over%205%20years%20at%207.9%25%20a%20year,%20paid%20monthly%20with%20nothing%20down%20and%20no%20fees,%20since%20none%20were%20mentioned&baseRf=4.5&why.baseRf=A%20typical%20savings%20or%20term%20deposit%20rate%20for%20the%20cash%20that%20is%20invested%20instead&note=Car%20purchase,%20October%202026

    Open the link to see the result.

    Open this scenario
    • Your figures stay yours. Anything you state goes in as you said it; correct any assumption and the AI sends a new link.
    • Checked before you see it. The skill's script checks every input's name, range and choices before the AI sends the link, so it opens the scenario listed.
    • The tool shows what the AI chose. When the link opens, a banner lists each value the AI set and why, with an Undo back to your own inputs.
